ho-kamae-1-seed-collaborator.title: Develop a project seed
ho-kamae-1-seed-collaborator.description: Work through the problem, intended users, constraints, and possible approaches. Draft a seed or revise one you already have.

ho-kamae-2-system-design-collaborator.title: Design the system
ho-kamae-2-system-design-collaborator.description: Use the completed seed to decide the architecture, compare alternatives, and record the reasons for your choices.

ho-kamae-3-readme-collaborator.title: Write the project README
ho-kamae-3-readme-collaborator.description: Describe the intended product and scope from the seed and system design. Update the README as the project changes.

ho-kamae-4-overview-collaborator.title: Plan the build sequence
ho-kamae-4-overview-collaborator.description: Organize the work into phases and hos, with dependencies, deferred decisions, and planned release points.

ho-kamae-5-authoring-collaborator.title: Prepare a working session
ho-kamae-5-authoring-collaborator.description: Define a ho's scope, decisions, and checks from the project plan. Update the document as the work develops and record the results afterward.

ho-setup-personal-environment-collaborat.title: Set up your Claude Code environment
ho-setup-personal-environment-collaborat.description: Configure the operating instructions, practitioner context, language conventions, and templates used across your Ho projects.

ho-setup-project-environment-collaborato.title: Set up a project
ho-setup-project-environment-collaborato.description: Create the repository structure and configure its development tools and checks using your Ho environment.

ho-tool-index-maintenance.title: Maintain the framework index
ho-tool-index-maintenance.description: Update document metadata and INDEX.md entries in the Ho System repository.
